title: HUD icon hover tooltips — explain power-ups + opponent badges with delayed text bubble on mouse-over
intent: S148 shipped the HUD icon grid (Layers 1+2 of GDP-2026-05-27-005) + S150 shipped opponent active-state badges. Players see the icons but mapping icon → power-up has to be MEMORISED (or learned from the brief pickup-tooltip moment at collect time, which is gone after 1.5s). A new player or a player returning after a break can't tell at a glance what the Pierce icon means vs Kick vs Throw Glove. Adding a HOVER TOOLTIP — 400ms delayed, dismissed on mouseleave — solves this without HUD clutter. Tooltip shows: icon, name, one-line description, current state (e.g. 'ACTIVE / LOCKED — collect the X pickup'). Applies to the local-player HUD strip AND to opponent active-state badges (so 'what does that opponent have?' is one hover away). Pure UX polish; no gameplay change.
rationale: Source: implicit gap from S148 + S150 — icons are recognisable to veterans, opaque to newcomers. The S148-shipped pickup-tooltip (Layer 2 of GDP-027-005) covers the LEARNING moment at collect time; this story covers the REMINDER moment afterwards. Standard UX pattern across every modern game with icon HUDs (Brawl Stars / Overwatch / Diablo IV / etc.). Marked `could` because the existing HUD is functional — this is onboarding + accessibility polish. Cheap to ship (~50 LOC + a small DOM overlay component).
acceptanceHints: DEPENDS ON: S148 (HUD icon grid Layers 1+2) + S150 (opponent badges) — both shipped. No protocol or gameplay changes.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/hud/icon-tooltip-system.ts: NEW. Single HUD-side overlay element reused across all icons.
TRIGGER:
Mouse hover on an icon DOM element AND hover sustained for 400ms → tooltip fades in (0.15s opacity tween).
Mouse leaves icon (or window blurred) → tooltip fades out (0.10s opacity tween).
Hovering a DIFFERENT icon while a tooltip is showing → instant transition (fade-out the old one, fade-in the new one over 0.10s).
Touch input: tap-and-hold (500ms+) on icon → tooltip shows. Lift finger or tap elsewhere → tooltip hides.
POSITION:
Tooltip floats ABOVE the hovered icon by default (icon's bottom edge = tooltip's top edge + 8px gap).
If the tooltip would render off the top of the screen (e.g. on a small browser window), flip to BELOW the icon.
Horizontally centred on the icon, clamp to screen bounds (1.5em from screen edge minimum).
STYLE:
Background: `#0f0f12` (HUD panel background per visual-style.md §8.2) at 92% opacity.
Border: 1px solid `#3a3a3f` (HUD divider colour). No rounded corners (industrial aesthetic per visual-style.md §2.1).
Inner padding: 8px.
Width: auto, max 240px. Single-line + wrap-to-3-lines max.
Font: monospace per visual-style.md §8.1, 13px (slightly smaller than HUD's 14px so tooltip reads as 'secondary').
Text colours: cream `#f4ede0` for primary (name + description), warm grey `#8a8580` for state subtitle.
TOOLTIP CONTENT — power-up icons (local-player HUD):
Bomb Up icon hover: 'Bomb Up — total bombs you can place at once' + state line '3 / 6' (current/max).
Fire Up icon hover: 'Fire Up — blast range in cells' + state '4 / 8'.
Speed Up icon hover: 'Speed Up — movement cells per second' + state '3 / 5'.
Kick icon hover (active): 'Kick — walk into your bomb to push it forward' + state 'ACTIVE'.
Kick icon hover (locked): 'Kick — walk into your bomb to push it forward' + state 'LOCKED — collect a Kick pickup'.
Remote / Shield / Pierce / Throw Glove / Bomb Pass: same active/locked pattern, each with its own one-line description.
Description text comes from a central registry (examples/kaboom-crew/src/hud/power-up-descriptions.ts) keyed by power-up name. Single source of truth for HUD text.
TOOLTIP CONTENT — opponent badges (Layer 3 from S150):
Hovering an opponent's Shield badge: 'Shield active — next blast won't kill them'.
Pierce badge: 'Pierce active — their bombs walk through first soft block'.
Remote badge: 'Remote active — they have armed bombs they can detonate'.
Throw badge: 'Throw active — they can pick up + throw their bombs'.

Opponent tooltips lead with the opponent's recipe-derived nickname or palette family if no nickname (e.g. 'Ember Bomber — Shield active'). Naming source: future multiplayer nameplate system; if not yet shipped, fall back to entity-id-based label.
TOOLTIP CONTENT — dash + sudden death (future-compat):
When dash (GDP-027-014) lands: dash icon hover 'Dash — burst 2 cells in facing direction' + 'READY' or 'COOLDOWN 1.2s'.
When sudden death (GDP-027-013) lands: no HUD icon, but the screen-edge red glow (from §3 visual treatment) gets its own hover-explanation tooltip 'Sudden Death — arena is shrinking'.
ACCESSIBILITY:
Keyboard navigation: each HUD icon DOM element gets `tabindex='0'`. Tab key cycles between icons. Focused icon shows the tooltip same as on mouse hover.
Screen reader: each icon has `aria-describedby` pointing to a hidden element with the tooltip text. Screen readers announce 'Kick — walk into your bomb to push it forward — ACTIVE'.
Reduced-motion preference: respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS query — disable the fade tweens; tooltip snaps in/out without animation.
PERFORMANCE: single shared tooltip element. Event delegation via DOM listener on the HUD container. No per-frame work; only on hover events. Negligible.
URL CONFIG:
`?hudTooltipsDelay=N` overrides the default 400ms hover delay (e.g. 100ms for testing, 1000ms for slower-reveal). Defaults to 400ms.
`?hudTooltips=off` disables tooltips entirely (for screenshot tests).
AGENT PROBE SURFACE:
`window.__agf.kaboom.tooltipFor(iconKey)` returns the tooltip text for a given icon. Useful for automated UI smoke tests asserting tooltips wire correctly.
UNIT TESTS:
Hover on kick icon (locked state) → tooltip text contains 'Kick' + 'LOCKED'.
Hover on kick icon (active state) → tooltip text contains 'Kick' + 'ACTIVE'.
Hover for 200ms then mouseleave → tooltip NEVER shows (delay not met).
Hover sustained 500ms → tooltip shows.
Hover icon A then immediately move to icon B → tooltip transitions to B's content within 100ms.
Keyboard focus on icon → tooltip behaves identically to mouse hover.
Touch tap-and-hold 600ms → tooltip shows.
Description text registry has an entry for every shipped power-up + opponent badge state.
PLAYTEST QA BAR:
A new player (no prior gameplay) hovers their HUD icons + correctly identifies what each power-up does without consulting external docs.
A returning player after a 1-week gap hovers icons + correctly recalls each power-up.
Opponent badges: hovering tells the player 'they have a shield' in <1 second.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Tooltips on minimap markers (separate UI surface; future polish).
Tooltips on accessory meshes on bombers (world-space; out — would need raycast).
Tooltips on hazard cells (Conveyor / Warp / Pressure Plate cells). Out — these are world-space, hover-on-world-cells is a different UX (raycast-driven).
Animated tooltip illustrations (gifs / videos demonstrating the power-up). Static text only.
Multi-language localisation. English text only in v1; description-registry is the seam where future i18n hooks in.
Tooltip dismiss via Escape key. Mouse-leave / focus-loss / tap-elsewhere is the standard hide path.
